hypotheses.text: CL uses at least 50% fewer LLM calls than L and its F1 is non-inferior (lower CI bound of F1(CL) - F1(L) above -0.03).
hypotheses.note: CL used 227 LLM calls, L used 324: 29.9% fewer. F1 CL 0.586, L 0.507. Item-level CI of the difference: [+0.004, +0.158].

hypotheses.text: Precision of CL is higher than precision of L.
hypotheses.note: Difference in precision CL - L. Raw p 0.0002, Holm-corrected 0.0008. Item-level CI: [+0.034, +0.200].

hypotheses.text: F1 of CL is higher than F1 of C (the LLM adds value to the rules).
hypotheses.note: Difference in F1 CL - C. Raw p 0.0004, Holm-corrected 0.0012. Item-level CI: [-0.013, +0.193].

hypotheses.text: F1 of Lf (LLM with the parser's analysis in the prompt) is higher than F1 of L.
hypotheses.note: Difference in F1 Lf - L. Raw p 0.0054, Holm-corrected 0.0108. Item-level CI: [-0.016, +0.106].

hypotheses.text: Swapping the product order flips the verdict of Lf less often than that of L.
hypotheses.note: Swap flip rate: L 0.260, Lf 0.140 on 100 pairs. Discordant pairs: L flipped only 17, Lf flipped only 5. Estimate = flip rate Lf - flip rate L. Raw p 0.0169, Holm-corrected 0.0169.

hypotheses.text: The publishable share of guarded copy is higher than that of raw copy.
hypotheses.note: Publishable share guarded 0.500 vs raw 0.267 (pooled over 30 bundles x 3 languages). Per language, difference [95% CI] and raw p: de: +0.200 [+0.067, +0.333] p=0.0042, en: +0.333 [+0.167, +0.500] p=0.0002, el: +0.167 [+0.033, +0.300] p=0.0114. Not part of the Holm family; raw p only.

hypotheses.text: The publishable share of delex copy is higher than that of raw copy.
hypotheses.note: Publishable share delex 0.200 vs raw 0.267 (pooled over 30 bundles x 3 languages). Per language, difference [95% CI] and raw p: de: -0.200 [-0.333, -0.067] p=0.0040, en: +0.100 [-0.133, +0.333] p=0.4806, el: -0.100 [-0.233, +0.000] p=0.0828. Not part of the Holm family; raw p only.
